$schemaNote: Report-only Phase 2 type-ratchet baseline. Do not tighten CI against this file until Andrew approves. When used as a ceiling, every count (totals, perGame, perFile, byCode) must be <= this snapshot.

phase1Reference.note: Phase 1 cleared src/ui + src/core + listed test helpers; left ~570 out-of-scope. Tip now reports 564 (delta from later folds).

reproduce.singleCommand: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.ratchet.json --pretty false 2>&1 | tee /tmp/type-ratchet-phase2-raw.txt | rg -c "error TS"
reproduce.verifyAgainstBaseline: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("docs/dev/type-ratchet-phase2-baseline.json","utf8")); const n=fs.readFileSync("/tmp/type-ratchet-phase2-raw.txt","utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>/error TS\d+:/.test(l)).length; if(n!==b.totals.outOfScopeErrors){console.error("MISMATCH raw="+n+" baseline="+b.totals.outOfScopeErrors); process.exit(1);} console.log("OK outOfScopeErrors="+n);'
notes: Phase 1 ratchet (npm run typecheck:ratchet) still only fails on src/ui + src/core + listed test helpers.
This baseline tracks ALL out-of-scope errors under tsconfig.ratchet.json (games AI/rules/UI/types + demos + main).
When used as a ceiling, every count in totals / perGame / perFile / byCode must be <= this snapshot (report-only until Andrew promotes).
